local_cpu.purpose: primary evidence for all 64 existing non-GPU workloads

remote_ai14.cpu_affinity: 64 explicit available logical CPU IDs, recorded in handoff/execution environment before launch
remote_ai14.purpose: primary evidence for the four GPU entries; three CPU entries additionally characterize the same remote host

coverage.aggregation: Use each entry once in the primary global comparison: local non-GPU entries plus remote GPU entries. Remote CPU duplicates are a separate hardware comparison and never double-weight global results. Missing entries remain open; a partial run cannot certify full acceptance.

estimated_runtime_budget.local_cpu: approximately 30-45 minutes; default common test workload dominates (one warmup plus five complete executions), based on the separately observed 247.56-second functional run, not a measured speed baseline
estimated_runtime_budget.remote: approximately 10-30 minutes after environment/model preparation; actual duration and shared load recorded, no manufactured timing guarantee
estimated_runtime_budget.memory: local available memory 446 GiB before science; remote per-device allocation/load is snapshotted, not reserved by this record

measurement_controls: No simultaneous task science/build/test work on the measured local host.
Cold import/test invocations use fresh processes; the manifest owns warmups and repetitions.
Source local timing deliberately measures the original common test/source contract; fresh wheel/native and installed smoke evidence is separately bound.
GPU shared-load conditions are observed honestly; equivalent final allocation and paired reruns are required, or timing remains inconclusive.
Per-site numeric/probability reports are untimed observations and do not enter performance aggregates.
No workload, repetition, quality threshold or scientific algorithm is reduced to obtain a speedup.
